messages:
Ruth: quick heads-up — I'm going to start a staggered apply of the new quota-rebalance flag on staging in 30m. want to validate we don't leak transient quota state across tenants :eyes:
Ben: +1. which flag key are you flipping? is this the operator-side join/leave window one?
Ruth: yeah `cfg.quota.rebalance.window_ms`. raising from 2000 -> 8000 to reduce churn during bursts.
Priya: hm we saw a similar change last quarter cause 'ghost' entitlements for ~10s while leases reconciled. can we run with `dry_run=true` first and compare effective quotas?
Ruth: plan is: 1) dry_run on a 5% cohort for 1 hour 2) enable telemetry sink for diff traces 3) gradual apply if no regressions.
Kai: for step 2 plz add cohort tagging in the trace so we can filter on the console. right now traces collapse tenant ids for PII reasons. we need cohort_id only.
Priya: also add an invariant check in the reconcile worker that emits a metric when delta>1 tenant-entitlement per owner. that'll let SRE alert quick.
Ben: can we avoid metric cardinality storm? emit a boolean gauge per shard like `quota.rebalance.leak_detected{shard="s-12"}` and a sampled event with tenant id when triggered.
Ruth: good call. I'll add: `quota.rebalance.leak_detected` boolean per pool and a `quota.rebalance.sampled_leaks` log with 1/100 sampling.
ops-bot: deploy-preview created for `ruth/rebalance-window-change` — diff: 3 files changed — http://ci.redwood/internal/5658
Priya: console UX: when the flag is dry_run, show a banner in the config editor and a toggle to roll-forward to full apply with an explicit ACK modal. users confused last time.
Kai: and capture the operator who clicked ACK + commit id in the audit ledger. we need deterministic for rollbacks.
Ben: API contract note: the runtime-config apply endpoint currently returns 200 before propagation completes. recommend returning 202 with a `preview_id` and a propagation ETA field so clients can poll.
Ruth: agree. i'll send a small API PR to change that semantics for preview endpoints only. keep current apply for emergency flows.
Priya: one more: create a replay job that can re-evaluate the sampled cohort input against prev/next windows so we can compute cost delta. useful for Optimize.
Ruth: yep adding replay. will also persist the preview snapshot to S3 (30d).
Kai: ok :thumbsup: add runbook note please — who unrolls if `leak_detected` fires repeatedly (2x in 15m). ops should get auto-pause.
Ruth: putting auto-pause threshold at 2 triggers in 15m, with manual override in console. will draft runbook now.
Ben: thanks — pls tag me on the PR for the metric name and the 1/100 sampling config.
Ruth: will do. launching dry_run in 25m.
ops-bot: reminder — staging maintenance window starts in 2h. may affect cohort sampling.
Priya: ack. I'll queue the replay job post-window.
Kai: nice and orderly. :shipit:
